method: Drafted by two independent Claude vision passes over 5 fps frame grids (one forward, one in reverse order); a sampled frame is kept where both agree (or one is certain and the other unsure). Each sample covers itself and the next 2 frames.
checkedBy: Aldo Tile, 2026-11-03, frame by frame in /label
